ABHIDHAMMATTHASAṄGAHA · PRINTABLE ACTIVE-RECALL DECK

Abhidhamma — 203 Flashcards

82 Ultimate Realities (Periodic Table: 1 Citta + 52 Cetasikas + 28 Rūpas + 1 Nibbāna)
+ 121 Canonical Cittas (Detailed Vitthāra Enumeration) + 4 Quick-Reference Cards

How to Print Accurately (Double-Sided A4 Duplex)

  1. Paper: A4 (210 × 297 mm). For playing-card feel, use 180–240 gsm matte cardstock (regular 90 gsm paper also works).
  2. Scale (CRITICAL): select 100% / Actual Size. Never choose “Fit to page” or “Shrink to printable area”, or front/back alignment will shift.
  3. Double-sided (Duplex): enable Flip on Long Edge. Odd pages (3, 5, 7 … 47) are FRONTS; even pages (4, 6, 8 … 48) are HORIZONTALLY MIRRORED BACKS (so on Page 4, P-01 sits at Top-Right to land directly behind Top-Left P-01 on Page 3!).
  4. Alignment test: print Pages 3–4 only first and hold the sheet up to light to verify front/back registration before printing the full deck.
  5. Cards only (skip this guide): print page range 3–48 (23 double-sided A4 sheets = 207 cards with zero wasted cardstock).
  6. Fast cutting: each sheet holds 9 cards at 64 × 92 mm (standard card size) — just 4 vertical + 4 horizontal cuts along the dashed guides.

Card Architecture

Front (Active Recall): canonical Pāli term/formula + family code/symbol + a concise structural Hint (group position, binary vector, or phalanx anchor — without spoiling the English rendering).

Back (Complete Answer): rigorous English rendering strictly following Bhikkhu Bodhi's A Comprehensive Manual of Abhidhamma (BPS), Lakkhaṇa (or Vedanā · Hetu · Jāti · Kicca), Sampayoga / Samuṭṭhāna / Saṅgaha-naya, and mnemonic Key.

Why 82 + 121 = 203 Cards?

The Periodic Table (82) enumerates the elementary subdivisions of the 4 Paramatthas (1 Citta + 52 Cetasikas + 18 concrete Rūpas + 1 Nibbāna = 72 sabhāvas; + 10 non-concrete Rūpas = 82).

The 121 Cittas are the combinatorial modes of Citta. Card P-01 is retained as the overview card for the paramattha Citta; B-01 to B-04 fill the final 4 slots of Sheet 23.

Terminology anchored strictly to Ācariya Anuruddha's Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha & Bhikkhu Bodhi's A Comprehensive Manual of Abhidhamma (BPS) · Guide Sheet (Page 1/2)

Recommended Memorization Protocol (Physical Leitner System)

Do not study all 203 cards at once. Master one sub-deck of 12–18 cards at a time across 3 physical stacks:

  • Stack 1 (Daily): new or missed cards — recite the Pāli aloud before flipping to check rendering, characteristic & cetasika count.
  • Stack 2 (Every 3 days): cards recalled accurately on the first try (any miss returns to Stack 1).
  • Stack 3 (Weekly): mastered cards — practice reverse recall too (read the English Back and reconstruct the exact Pāli formula!).

Suggested order: ① 13 Ethically Variable + 14 Unwholesome Cetasikas → ② 12 Unwholesome Cittas → ③ 18 Rootless Cittas → ④ 25 Beautiful Cetasikas + 24 Sense-Sphere Beautiful → ⑤ 15 Fine-Material + 12 Immaterial + 40 Supramundane → ⑥ 28 Rūpas + Citta/Nibbāna.

B-01 · Reference Bonus
Atoms (82) × Molecules (89/121)
72 Sabhāva-dhammas: 1 Citta + 52 Cetasikas + 18 Nipphanna-Rūpas + 1 Nibbāna.
+ 10 Anipphanna-Rūpas (1+2+3+4) = 82 subdivisions of the 4 Paramatthas.
89 Cittas (Saṅkhepa): 12 Aku + 18 Ahe + 24 Kām + 15 Rūp + 12 Arū + 8 Lok.
121 Cittas (Vitthāra): same 81 mundane + 40 Supramundane (8 × 5 Jhānas).

B-04 · Reference Bonus
Ontological Exclusions (Ch. II)
1. Akusala × Sobhana: unwholesome & beautiful never coexist.
2. Lobha × Dosa: attraction & repulsion never coexist.
3. Diṭṭhi × Māna: “two lions cannot share one cave”.
4. Issā × Macchariya × Kukkucca: only 1 at a time in Dosa.
5. Adhimokkha × Vicikicchā: decision excludes doubt (#11).
6. Karuṇā × Muditā: opposite objects; never in J5/Lok.
7. Thīna+Middha: inseparable pair, only in 5 prompted Akusalas.
8. Pīti: requires Somanassa and Jhāna ≤ 3.
Reference 4/4 · AS II.10–17 203 + 4 Bonus
B-03 · Reference Bonus
Steps J1 → J5 (Rūpa × Lokuttara)
J1: Vt·Vc·Pī·Su·Ek → Rūpa 35 · Lok 36
J2 (−Vt): Vc·Pī·Su·Ek → Rūpa 34 · Lok 35
J3 (−Vt,Vc): Pī·Su·Ek → Rūpa 33 · Lok 34
J4 (−Pīti): Su·Ek → Rūpa 32 · Lok 33
J5 (Su→Up): Up·Ek → Rūpa/Arūpa 30 · Lok 33
Key diff.: Rūpa J1–J4 admits +2 Appamaññā; Lokuttara has +3 fixed Viratis (and 0 Appam.).
Reference 3/4 · AS II.36–39 203 + 4 Bonus
B-02 · Reference Bonus
The 3 Switches [V · C · S]
Bit 1 — Vedanā (V): 1 = Somanassa (w/ Pīti) · 0 = Upekkhā (no Pīti).
Bit 2 — Cognitive (C): in Lobha: 1 = Diṭṭhi / 0 = no Diṭṭhi (+Māna occ.). In Kāmasobhana: 1 = Ñāṇa (Tihetuka) / 0 = no Ñāṇa (Dvihetuka).
Bit 3 — Saṅkhāra (S): 1 = Asaṅkhārika (unprompted) · 0 = Sasaṅkhārika (prompted; in Akusala +Thīna-Middha).
Order #1→#8: 111 · 110 · 101 · 100 · 011 · 010 · 001 · 000.
